summary: Frontend-only regression for the NEW selective country-privacy feature (replacing prior 'blur all words' behavior). Executed 49 assertions across 6 scenarios: normal visitor, blocked visitor via window.restrictSensitive(), safe-parts-remain-normal, admin COUNTRIES tab, window.enforceGeoBlock() branch logic (empty blocklist / admin-logged-in / country match US / country non-match FR — fetch monkeypatched), and general regressions. 46/49 asserted checks pass; the 3 failing lines are test-assertion mismatches (not app bugs) as noted below. The feature works exactly as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.js enforceGeoBlock() catches ALL errors silently (try/catch with empty catch) — if ipapi.co is blocked/rate-limited the site simply behaves as unrestricted. That is acceptable failure-open behavior for privacy-of-inconvenience but should be a conscious choice.

restrictSensitive() only removes <option> nodes matching /in person/i. If the admin later adds another in-person-tell string (e.g. 'IRL meet'), it will leak through. Consider centralizing the sensitive-tell regex.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage 'candice_blocked_countries' was toggled and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested scenarios verified. Normal visitor: nav shows ABOUT·EXPERIENCES·GALLERY·TRAVEL·BOOK·PAY·FAQ·CONNECT, travel section shows Dubai + '24 / 7' + Meet-me button, in-person card visible, booking toggle visible, in-person option present, geo-blur banner hidden. Blocked visitor (window.restrictSensitive()): body gets .geo-blur, #travel .restrict-hide -> display:none, #travel [data-testid=travel-restricted-msg] shown with 'Kept private in your region.' text, in-person experience card display:none, nav TRAVEL wrapper display:none, booking toggle field display:none, no in-person <option> remain, [data-testid=geo-blur-banner] display:flex with correct text, hero color rgb(246,236,221) fully readable. Safe parts (gallery/faq/payments/contact sections and booking form name/message/submit) all present and functional under geo-blur. Admin: Ctrl+Shift+K -> pass candice2026 -> COUNTRIES tab -> search 'united states' -> click row -> localStorage['candice_blocked_countries'] = ["US"]; click again -> []. enforceGeoBlock branches: empty blocklist returns early (no fetch, no blur); admin session set returns early (no fetch, no blur); monkeypatched fetch returning {country_code:'US'} triggers restrictSensitive (body.geo-blur added); {country_code:'FR'} does not. Regression: CONNECT nav border transparent, Telegram/WhatsApp/Snapchat/Teams/WeChat pills present, Microsoft Teams + WeChat contact cards present, no Bluesky. The three 'FAIL' lines printed during automation were test-assertion issues, NOT app bugs: (1) 'travel section shows 24/7' — actual DOM text is '24 / 7' (spaces around slash); (2) 'pay section visible' — element id is 'payments' not 'pay'; (3) 'connect section visible' — element id is 'contact' not 'connect'. Nav PAY and CONNECT both correctly scroll to those sections. No action items for main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end. The 3 assertion 'failures' were incorrect id / text expectations in my Playwright script (section ids are 'payments' and 'contact'; travel text is '24 / 7'). Reproduction of correct behavior is documented in context_for_next_testing_agent.
